title: Vampire Vape Catapult Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Catapult Nic Salt by Vampire Vape is a mouth-watering fusion of juicy summer fruits and tart blackcurrants shot through with a fresh hit of mint and menthol cool for a refreshing and perfectly balanced vape. This premium Catapult Vampire Vape Nic Salt E-Liquid's 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Making this Catapult Vampire Vape Nic Salt E-Liquid the perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
